_comment: food_drink_flavor.json - random flavor line shown whenever the player eats or drinks (manually via the inventory Eat/Drink button, or automatically when hunger/thirst runs low). %s is replaced with the item's name. Edit or add to these lists freely - player3d.gd picks one at random via NPCFlavorText.get_line('eat'/'drink') from consume_food_or_drink().
eat: You consume %s. Yumm! That was tasty!
You wolf down %s. That hit the spot!
You eat %s. Not bad at all.
You devour %s, feeling a bit better already.
You eat %s, and your stomach thanks you for it.
drink: You quench your thirst with %s. Ahhh! That hit the spot.
You down %s in a few quick gulps.
You drink %s, washing the dust from your throat.
